summary: The AI Engineer Associate designs, builds, and deploys Generative AI applications in coordination with the AI Innovation team.
responsibilities: Develop and deploy production-grade Generative AI applications
Engage in full-stack development, contributing to both the front-end and back-end of AI-powered applications
Implement and maintain MLOps pipelines for continuous integration, delivery, and monitoring of AI models
Contribute to the end-to-end ML model development lifecycle
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code
Assist in evaluating and integrating new AI technologies and frameworks
required_skills: Experience with relevant frameworks (e.g., Flask, FastAPI, LangChain, Hugging Face)
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with MLOps principles and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Sagemaker)
nice_to_have_skills: Strong understanding of the Gen AI development process
education_level: Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
benefits: Citi is an equal opportunity employer
